_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): app layout shell — header + collapsible sidebar + content outlet + footer. Uses [[ ]] delimiters so it never collides with JS/HTML template syntax.
name: comp-layout
description: App layout shell: sticky header, collapsible sidebar, content outlet, footer. Place in src/components/.
notes: Usage: <Layout title='My App' nav={[{key:'home',label:'Home',href:'/'}]} activeKey='home' headerRight={<button>}>{page}</Layout>. Self-contained, no extra deps. Pair with comp-login for the auth gate.
